Founded In Noosa, Qld In 2009 As A Sanctuary For Healing

Escape the pressures of daily life with a 360 degree holistic mental health retreat designed for Australians seeking rest, clarity, health transformation, de stress, emotional healing and full life renewal using a proven process designed for empowering individuals to recover their mental health and create a life they love.

Whether you are ready to overcome trauma, anxiety, grief, low mood and sadness, restore your health or are ready for a complete 360° lifestyle transformation, Alive Luxury Retreats offers deeply personalised programs designed to restore balance on every level with the support of a full integrative team.

Alive Luxury Wellness Retreats opened in Noosa, QLD Australia in 2009 as one of the world’s first holistic mental health retreats, setting a new global benchmark long before wellness retreats became mainstream. In 2013, Alive expanded internationally, opening its now flagship retreat centre in Bali and now Mexico, where it continues to deliver world-leading wellness and mental health retreats today grounded in experience, integrity, and proven results.

This is more than a retreat. It’s a return to who you are meant to be supported by a team who has been guiding life-changing wellness and mental health transformations for Australians since 2009.

blocks.text: 360 Expert Holistic Team

We start with a complete picture of your wellbeing understanding the whole person — physical, emotional, mental, relational, and lifestyle. Our detailed 360 degree assessments help us tailor a program that meets your unique needs and ensures your retreat delivers the transformation you’re seeking.
Regain Inner Calm With Mind Tools

Discover inner calm and clarity through proven practices like mindfulness, meditation, breathwork, and deep relaxation. These tools help you recenter during life’s challenges and cultivate a long-lasting sense of peace and self-awareness.
Reconnect With Your body & Life

Movement becomes joyful again with activities designed to meet you where you are. From yoga therapy and functional fitness classes to guided hikes and adventures in nature, our fitness approach is about feeling strong, energised, and alive in your own body.
Heal With A Proven System

Experience the Alive Powerful 8 Steps for Mental Health, a holistic approach to heal the physical, mental, emotional, and energetic drivers of mental health challenges. Our expert team offers transformative coaching masterclasses that equip you with essential tools for lasting change. Start journey to well-being and unlock your potential today!
Inspiring 1:1 Therapy

Through private sessions with our executive level life and wellness coaches or holistic counsellors, hypnotherapists, and holistic healers, you’ll experience powerful insights and breakthroughs. Our focus is forward-looking — helping you release old patterns and step fully into the greatest version of yourself.
Spa, Massage & Relaxation

With healing spa and massage sessions you experience hands on nurturing and stress release. Time to rest and reflect daily in the privacy of your own luxury beachfront pool villa or surrounding areas for deep reflection and peace.
Physical Healing & Relief

From customised nutrition and detox plans, natural medicine, cleansing, biohacking including IV and ozone therapy, we focus on restoring balance across your whole body. The result is renewed energy, deeper sleep, and a vibrant sense of wellness that lasts long beyond your retreat.
Emotional Healing Therapies

Your one on one healing sessions help you emotionally release what you are holding onto and reset hidden patterns that are driving the unconscious behaviours that cause burn out, exhaustion and overwhelm. Work with healers, kinesiologists, somatic breathwork practitioners that suit you personally to release the old and welcome the new.
New Purpose & Life Direction

Clarity creates momentum. With expert guidance, you’ll rediscover your passions, define your goals, and design an inspiring plan for your next chapter. Supported by our ongoing aftercare, you’ll leave not just with insight, but with motivation and a clear path forward.
